name: listAvg
description: Calculates average from all numeric values given in the list

params.name: delimiters
params.description: Characters that separate list elements. The default value is comma.

params.name: multiCharacterDelimiter
params.description: specifying whether the delimiters parameter specifies a multi-character delimiter. If this parameter is true, the delimiters parameter must specify a single delimiter consisting of multiple characters. This parameter enables the ListToArray function to convert a list such as the following to an array of color names: red:|orange:|yellow:|green:|blue:|indigo:|violet.
